description: Built the full engineering stack for an EU-hosted AI chat platform operated by Bergwaldprojekt eV that offsets the environmental impact of AI usage by funding real-world reforestation per square meter, based on energy and water consumption. Forked from LibreChat with GDPR-compliant EU hosting. Architected LiteLLM-based agentic model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, the entire EUR billing pipeline with auto-recharge Stripe wallets handling 10,000+ daily sessions, a Chrome extension that tracks token consumption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, and shipped cross-platform mobile apps via Capacitor.
highlights: Configured LiteLLM as a unified proxy so agent workflows can switch between GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini mid-task — metering and billing stay identical across models
Built environmental accounting into the billing pipeline: each session's token count maps to a reforestation spend via Bergwaldprojekt eV
EUR-based billing pipeline with auto-recharge, processing 10,000+ daily sessions via Stripe at sub-second latency
Chrome extension tracking real-time token usage across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
Cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android shipped with Capacitor (100% app-store approval)

description: Led a 3-person engineering team shipping three products simultaneously — Jeofferte (quote marketplace), Meshi (food-tech with geo-based matching), and Roofcast (Web3 prediction market on Polygon). Owned architecture decisions, code review, and deployment pipelines across all three.
highlights: Roofcast: Web3 prediction-market DApp on Polygon with Gnosis Conditional Tokens and USDC on-chain settlement
Jeofferte: quote marketplace with instant supplier matching via background pre-processing
Meshi: geo-based food matching engine with PostGIS and real-time availability

description: Led Web3 initiatives at Exmodules, building DApp Solutions — a blockchain-based real estate platform enabling users to buy or rent property with cryptocurrency — and facilitating token creation. Smart contracts handle the full transaction lifecycle, with funds locked and released only after document verification. Built a generic data-fetching hook and a reusable CRUD table within a modular headless component architecture.
highlights: Smart contracts managing full property transaction lifecycle with fund escrow
WalletConnect integration for wallet-based authentication and on-chain signing
SEO-optimized responsive frontend with Web3 wallet interaction

description: Built real-time cryptocurrency trading interfaces with TradingView charts and WebSocket feeds. Improved load times from 4.2s to 2.9s and introduced PWA with hybrid caching. Built a shared component library that cut feature delivery from 8 to 5 days. Mentored two junior developers.
highlights: Platform load time optimized from 4.2s to 2.9s via bottleneck analysis
PWA with hybrid caching: cache-first for static assets, network-first for APIs
Component library cutting feature delivery from 8 to 5 days, mentored 2 juniors
